title: docs(pm-dispatch): name objectstack-fleet[bot] as the write identity
body:
Fixes #19881

Clause-②: no

## What changed

Two lines of the pm-dispatch skill still named `claude[bot]` as the write identity. `claude[bot]` is the REST-proxy installation identity, and it has been superseded. `AGENTS.md` is the authority: "Every GitHub write leaves through `scripts/pm/`, as `objectstack-fleet[bot]`, behind the shared write gate." Both lines now say that, edited in place:

```diff
 .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md:94
-- 写侧恒走 `claude[bot]` ⛔ 不走用户令牌;节奏 ≥3 秒/笔、每账号每小时 ≤40 笔,429 即停写。
+- 写侧恒为 `objectstack-fleet[bot]`(AGENTS.md);节奏 ≥3 秒/笔、每账号每小时 ≤40 笔,429 即停写。

 .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/filing-gate.md:31
-- 立卡、开 PR 与评论恒走 App 安装身份(`claude[bot]`),⛔ 不走席位用户令牌。
+- 立卡、开 PR 与评论恒经 `scripts/pm/` 为 `objectstack-fleet[bot]`(AGENTS.md),⛔ 不走席位用户令牌。
```

Ruling (verbatim, untranslated):

> 另外注意 pm-dispatch 技能文档里有一处过时:SKILL.md:94 和 references/filing-gate.md:31 还写着"写侧恒走 claude[bot]" 这个是错的，立卡修改
> 你可以直接派发修改

## Why the lines read the way they do

- `check-skill-line-ratchet` holds both files at zero line headroom: SKILL.md is at 319 of 319 lines and filing-gate.md is at 58 of 58. It also caps every line at 120 bytes. The old SKILL.md:94 was 119 bytes, and `objectstack-fleet[bot]` is 11 bytes longer than `claude[bot]`.
- The pacing half of SKILL.md:94 is 67 bytes and is kept byte-identical. With it in place, the identity, the user-token clause and an authority pointer cannot all fit: the shortest line that holds all three is 127 bytes.
- So the new SKILL.md:94 keeps the identity and the AGENTS.md pointer, and drops the user-token clause. Nothing is lost:
  - SKILL.md:92 already says user accounts have exactly three uses, and none of them is a write.
  - filing-gate.md:31 still carries its own user-token prohibition for filing cards, opening PRs and commenting.
- SKILL.md:94 does not list the `scripts/pm/` doors (`issue-create`, `label-write`, `post-stamped`, `close-cards`, `with-fleet.sh`), because they would not fit under the cap either. The AGENTS.md pointer names them, and filing-gate.md:31 names `scripts/pm/`.
- filing-gate.md:9 is a verbatim maintainer quote that names `claude(bot)`. It is untouched. The optional one-line note under it was not added: the file has zero line headroom, and line 31, now 119 bytes, has no room to carry the note.

## Lines re-read and left unchanged

- `references/platform-readings.md:130` and `:132` are dated measurements of the container's REST-proxy token classes. They are not a write rule.
- `references/platform-readings.md:136` tells a seat not to assume a write is signed as `claude[bot]`. That agrees with the new identity. It is not an instruction to write as `claude[bot]`.
- `references/filing-gate.md:32-33` say to read back `user.type` on a fire's first write, and to stop filing if it reads `User`. A write through the doors reads back `Bot`, so a `User` readback still flags a write that went around them. These lines are not an instruction to write as `claude[bot]`.

At `1be1a7d`, the acceptance grep `git grep -n 'claude\[bot\]' -- .claude/skills/pm-dispatch` hits exactly three lines: `platform-readings.md:130`, `:132` and `:136`. That is the list above, and none of them prescribes a write identity.

  - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint run check:doc-formula-expressions` first exited 3 because a prerequisite was not built. It exited 0 after `turbo run build --filter=@objectstack/formula --filter=@objectstack/lint`.

## Acceptance notes

- **Changeset:** this is a `.claude/**`-only diff, which is the fast lane and publishes nothing, so no changeset is written. `Check Changeset` stays red until the `skip-changeset` label is on this PR. This dispatch's write budget has no label write, so the label is not applied here and is owed by the seat.
- **Landing tier:** the dispatch described this diff as Tier H. The register (`GOVERNED_SURFACES` in `scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs`) rows `.claude/**` as Tier S. The PR stays draft either way.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

**改了什么**:pm-dispatch 技能里有两行把 GitHub 写身份写成 `claude[bot]`,现在都改成 `objectstack-fleet[bot]`,并注明以 AGENTS.md 为准。两行是 `SKILL.md:94` 和 `references/filing-gate.md:31`。只改这两行,两个文件的行数都不变。

**为什么改**:AGENTS.md 规定,所有 GitHub 写都经 `scripts/pm/` 以 `objectstack-fleet[bot]` 身份发出。技能文档还写着旧身份,只读技能的席位会被引向错误身份。这既与 AGENTS.md 矛盾,也与同一技能的 `rest-channel.md` 矛盾。本卡按您的原话裁决直派。

**风险与代价(含回滚)**:
- 纯内部文档改动,不发布,不影响运行时。
- 行棘轮规定每行不超过 120 字节,所以 `SKILL.md:94` 删去了“⛔ 不走用户令牌”半句。这个意思在同文件第 92 行已经有了,`filing-gate.md:31` 也仍然保留,规则没有丢。
- 回滚就是 revert 本 PR 的单个提交。

**席位意见**:

**你要做的**:
- 按登记册,`.claude/**` 属 Tier S,由席位的达档复核 PASS 记录放行落地,不需要您点批准。
- 按派发,已请 os-zhuang、hotlong 复审;如果您想按 Tier H 处理,需要其中一人批准一次。
- `skip-changeset` 标签由席位补挂。
